digest.component_or_area: type checking configuration and Mypy strictness flags
propositions: Enable four Mypy strictness flags globally (no_implicit_optional, strict_equality, warn_redundant_casts, warn_unused_ignores) while explicitly deferring disallow_any_generics and disallow_untyped_defs.
A redundant int cast exists at editor.py:515 that must be removed after confirming it is redundant via Mypy in the canonical fully provisioned CI environment.

Unused type: ignore suppressions exist across 26 diagnostics in 22 files; each must be individually validated in the canonical environment and removed only when proven stale, or preserved and narrowed/documented if contingent on optional dependencies or Mypy version.
The ratchet test must assert that the four approved strictness flags are enabled and disallow_any_generics and disallow_untyped_defs are not enabled globally.
After remediation, mypy src/rebar --warn-redundant-casts and mypy src/rebar --warn-unused-ignores must exit 0 against current origin/main with all diagnostics resolved.
